TRIP_RE = re.compile(r"^- \*\*(ID|Trigger|Check):\*\*\s*(.+)$", re.M)

def match_tripwires(prompt: str, trips: list[dict], limit: int = 5) -> list[dict]:
    hits = [t for t in trips if re.search(t["trigger"], prompt, re.I)]
    return hits[:limit]
